title: Homothetic rescalings restricted to open sets preserve integrality
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U, O ⊆ ℝ^N, V an n-varifold on U and W an n-varifold on O (so U and O are open), ξ ∈ ℝ^N and t > 0 with ξ + t·y ∈ U for every y ∈ O. If V is integral and W.measure = (rescaledMeasure V ξ t).restrict (O × G(N,n)), i.e. W = V_{ξ,t} ⌞ G_n(O), then W is integral.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U O : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (W : Varifold N n O) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → (∀ y ∈ O, ξ + t • y ∈ U) → IsIntegral V → W.measure = (rescaledMeasure V ξ t).restrict (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → IsIntegral W
